# Third-party notice: sugar-high

Tarball sha256: `6980beb290432b5ea3c762dda8724993e3a4490bd82e7f37ed071fc42e90a1cf`. Re-vendor by replacing the folder whole.

It runs only at build time (`../highlight.mjs`); shipped HTML contains its output spans, never its code.
